text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] kv-prefetch path error rate spiked ~3x for models {mistral-1, qwen-1}. Source: continuous-batching + KV cache growth. Paging oncall.

alex: oncall here, ack. opening dashboards now — jumping into traces.

maria: quick note: continuous_batch_queue length for mistral routes shot up 5x at 12:00. KV cache working set grew dramatically (per-shard occupancy ~78%). looks like prefetch expansion + GQA requests with long prefixes.

alex: seeing the same. 5xx is mostly kv lookup timeouts and kv eviction thrash. latency SLOs blown on a handful of customers.

jon: tagging customer-impact: 2 paying customers on dedicated pools saw elevated p99 gen latency -> 4xx/5xx. small but important.

len: logs show a new prefetch heuristic rolled out yesterday to increase prefix prefetch to reduce cold-starts. suspecting prefetch overfetch for GQA-heavy traffic.

ops-chris: can we throttle prefetch or roll back heuristic quickly? If we reduce prefetch we should reduce cache working set and eviction churn.

maria: agreed. mitigation plan: (1) disable prefetch for mistral routes, (2) lower continuous batching window / max batch size for affected routes, (3) temporarily increase kv eviction threshold to reduce thrash.

alex: can someone run the quick config change? I'll coordinate customer comms and onboard SRE.

deploy-bot: run request received: `rictl apply --patch prefetch_disable_mistral` queued.

maria: applying hotfix now — patch: 
```
PATCH /runtime/config
{
  "route_filters": {"model_family":"mistral"},
  "prefetch_enabled": false,
  "continuous_batch_max_size": 8,
  "continuous_batch_window_ms": 60,
  "kv_cache_eviction_threshold": 0.70
}
```

deploy-bot: hotfix deployed to 3 regions (us-west1, eu-central1, us-east1). Canary success: 3/3.

alex: early signals: kv working set down ~30% in canaries, 5xxs trending down. throttling remaining routes gradually.

jon: rolling to prod groups A,B now — watch for regression on small-latency customers.

len: note: qwen routes also show minor correlation, but their prefetch heuristic is different. I'm patching qwen to reduce prefetch batch size (not full disable).

ops-chris: push traffic normalizing. still seeing a residual p99 for long-prefix GQA flows, but within SLO in most regions.

alex: filing initial incident rundown to customers hit. Will include timelines + mitigation steps.

sre-bot: action item created: SRE-1243 "Investigate prefetch heuristic regression and add guardrails" assigned to len, due in 3 days.

maria: followup checks: add a circuit-breaker that disables prefetch if KV eviction rate > 40% for 2 mins. Also add metric alert for continuous_batch_queue > 100 for any route.

alex: agreed. I'll own customer comms + postmortem. jon, len, maria, ops-chris please prepare short notes for RCA.

jon: summarizing customer impact: two paying customers experienced >500ms p99 increase and intermittent 5xx for ~18 minutes during peak. No data loss.

maria: root cause hypothesis: recent prefetch heuristic increased speculative prefix expansion for GQA/MQA traffic; combined with a growth in long-prefix requests this expanded KV working sets and triggered eviction thrash; continuous batching window increased queueing causing more concurrent KV reads and higher tail latencies.

len: long-term mitigations: adjust heuristic with per-route token-limit, add prefetch budget per-shard, and enforce KV working-set cap with backpressure to request routers.

alex: thanks all. handing off to post-incident channel for writeup. leaving this thread open for 1hr for any late telemetry. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — root mitigation applied, customer impact reduced, monitoring set.
